answer: Require every agent to lock a refundable stake in escrow before trading, and tie that stake to a reputation history that only honest work builds: each verified job earns a small non-transferable credit no newcomer can buy. A fake identity is like a relic on a reef — alone, with no record of useful work, so peers refuse its offers until it has done real jobs. The attacker must pay a stake for every echo of itself and wait out the same slow earning period, so forging a thousand identities costs a thousand stakes and a thousand waiting periods while honest agents keep earning.
